intentions.title: Give Studio a self-documenting, runnable API catalog covering every public HTTP surface (query, mutate, history, export, webhooks, analytics, SSE) instead of a static reference doc
intentions.evidence: Each module (query.ex, mutate.ex, history.ex, export.ex, webhooks.ex, misc.ex) builds an entries/1 catalog of maps with id/category/label/method/path_template/description/response_shape/possible_errors — data structures clearly meant to render as a docs+playground pane and to actually be executed (`runnable: true`), not just read.

intentions.title: Make every catalog entry directly executable against a live dataset with pre-filled realistic examples, so the docs pane doubles as an interactive Postman-style tester
intentions.evidence: body_example fields with concrete payloads (e.g. mutate.ex playground-create-#{unique_integer} ids for idempotent re-runs), path_params with defaults, query_params with options, and `runnable: true` flags across query.ex, history.ex, webhooks.ex, export.ex.

intentions.title: Encode expected outcomes (status codes + assertion labels) per endpoint and per scenario so the catalog also functions as an executable conformance/smoke-test suite
intentions.evidence: `expect: {200, :envelope_has_reserved_keys}` etc. plus `scenarios` lists with `path_overrides`/`query_overrides`/`no_auth: true`/expected error codes (e.g. query.ex 'nonexistent type → 404', webhooks.ex 'no auth → 401', misc.ex analytics empty-dataset/no-auth cases) — this is a test matrix, not just documentation.

intentions.title: Teach API consumers the draft/publish lifecycle and revision model through worked, chained examples rather than prose alone
intentions.evidence: mutate.ex chains createOrReplace→publish→unpublish/discardDraft/delete in single body_example transactions demonstrating the drafts.<id> convention; history.ex explains revision snapshots per mutation and restore-to-draft semantics without auto-publishing.

intentions.title: Document and enforce per-endpoint auth tiers (public / token / admin) as first-class catalog metadata so the playground can gate execution and the docs communicate access requirements accurately
intentions.evidence: Every entry carries `auth: :public | :token | :admin` (webhooks.ex uses :admin for list/create/delete; query.ex uses :public for list/search; mutate.ex/history.ex/export.ex use :token) consistently paired with `possible_errors` including :unauthorized/:forbidden.

intentions.title: Keep the catalog maintainable by splitting one large facade into per-category modules that are moved verbatim and concatenated in stable order
intentions.evidence: Every module's @moduledoc states it was 'Split out of Barkpark.ApiTester.Endpoints (the facade) — each entry is moved verbatim' and entries/1 returns 'this category's slice ... in the exact order the facade concatenates it', with misc.ex explicitly folding Analytics+Real-time together 'to keep the module count lean (YAGNI)'.
